ai_summary: Aptech Limited has secured a domestic contract valued at an estimated Rs. 2.24 crores from an autonomous body under State Government, reinforcing its core vocational training business through a Skilling Course training program. The material impact includes this new revenue stream, with execution scheduled to commence in Q3 of FY 2026-27. While the specific government entity is not named, there are no indicated red flags concerning related party transactions or promoter interest.
